name: START
source:
Daydreaming about his childhood girl at work gets a frypan on his head from the same girl. Thus starts this girl chase game. He can go after 5 girls, while bringing up stats that the girls like. Most girls know/love him from before, he just have to get close to them to find out. Hope he can start a new life with the girl he loves.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403171040/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wns.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
上班时做着青梅竹马的白日梦，结果被同一个女孩用平底锅砸了脑袋。就这样，一场追逐女孩的游戏开始了。他可以追求5个女孩，同时提升她们喜欢的属性值。大多数女孩之前就认识/喜欢他，他只需要接近她们去发现这一点。希望他能和心爱的女孩开始新的生活。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403171040/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wns.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
